Name: Harem Valley-caroline(Childhood Sweetheart Caroline)Compatibility
Author: CokeCharger
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This compatibility patch modifies both Caroline's portraits and the relevant code from the "Harem Valley" mod to match the style of "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)", ensuring both mods work together seamlessly.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Make sure you have the latest versions of both "Harem Valley" and "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)" installed. 
2. Download this mod file. 
3. Replace the original portrait files in your "Harem Valley" mod folder with the files from this patch. 
4. Ensure this patch loads **after** both base mods in your mod load order (adjust via SMAPI if needed).

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

- Modified Caroline portraits from "Harem Valley" to match the "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)" style 
- Code edits to resolve conflicts and ensure full compatibility between the two mods 
- No changes to original game or mod content, only portrait compatibility fixes


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- The "Harem Valley" mod by Feldspar110 [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- The "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)" mod by Solariaze [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220[/url][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38552]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38552[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to **Feldspar110**, the original creator of the "Harem Valley" mod, and to **Solariaze**, the author of "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)". This patch only involves simple edits to make their amazing works compatible with each other. If there is any copyright infringement, please contact me to remove this content promptly. [/color]
